title: ネオン模様
artist: 真夜中シアター feat. MC 夜風
caption: 1980s Japanese city pop with a guest rap verse. A glamorous, smoky female lead vocal sings the verses and chorus in Japanese; midway through, a smooth male MC raps a verse in Japanese over the groove. Four-on-the-floor disco-funk drums with handclaps, driving slap bass, scratchy rhythm guitar, sparkling electric piano, lush string synthesizer, bright horn section riffs. Glamorous, bittersweet, strangers dancing close in a neon-lit club. Warm analog tape sound.
